title: Hⁿ scaling law for the dilation η_{x,r}: measurable embedding and measure preservation
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^P, r > 0 and η(y) := r⁻¹(y − x). Then η : ℝ^P → ℝ^P is a measurable embedding, and η is measure preserving from c·Hⁿ to Hⁿ, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] and c = ENNReal.ofReal((rⁿ)⁻¹); equivalently η_*(c·Hⁿ) = Hⁿ, i.e. Hⁿ(η⁻¹(B)) = rⁿ·Hⁿ(B) for every Borel B.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → MeasurableEmbedding (fun y : Eucl P => r⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∧ MeasurePreserving (fun y : Eucl P => r⁻¹ • (y - x)) (ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ n)⁻¹) • (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
